items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: Louis Cantrell on drums. And myself on drumming on.

ctx.x: Oh, I see. That was his son. He did too. John Veen playing piano. Celeste on the clarinet. Theo on clarinet. Louis Cantrell on drums. And myself on drumming on. Did you name a bass player? Billy has no bass player. And no banjo? Guitar? Did you name somebody I can't remember? How busy is going to sleep. Look like it ain't. If you getting tired we'll turn this thing off.
All right. I guess you better. Yeah. Okay.

items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: Yeah. He played a while with us.

ctx.x: Did you play with Louie Cottrell in your band ever?

Yeah. He played a while with us. I tell him and Pierron went to Chicago for a while. Louie, I think Teo, Grantio, Pierron, I think Joyce, no not Teo didn't go, but Joyce Backhead. Joyce Backhead. Yes. Joyce Backhead. There was four or five of them left here. But they didn't stay very long up there. But that's when Louie Cottrell had them playing with us. That's why he got away from Muslin, you see. I remember the Chicago.
Did you ever hear Buddy Bolden's band? Do you remember?
